method: Manual initializer and mutation dispositions supplement lexical references. Memory preview/salt assignments are not classified as state mutation; tuple writes, AddressSet accessors and route storage aliases are explicitly included. No formal alias proof claimed.

fields.name: detf
fields.disposition: _initialize; owning DETF immutable

fields.name: lpToken
fields.disposition: _initialize; protocol LP custody token

fields.name: reservedIdsWired
fields.disposition: false at deployment; one-time initializeReservedBondNfts

fields.name: attributedGons
fields.disposition: zero at deployment; _open/_claim/_retireIfPaid exact aggregate escrow

fields.name: positions
fields.disposition: empty mapping; _open fixes principal/start/duration and measured gons; claims update only purchased ID

fields.name: detf
fields.disposition: _initialize; authenticated nine-decimal backing

fields.name: bondNftVault
fields.disposition: _initialize; only escrow may retire its fractions

fields.name: feeOracle
fields.disposition: _initialize; live fee recipient lookup

fields.name: synchronizing
fields.disposition: false at deployment; _synchronize callback guard

fields.name: gonsPerUnit
fields.disposition: _initialize = 1e36; _distribute tuple assignment applies funded _rebase only

fields.name: totalGons
fields.disposition: zero at deployment; issue/debit/retire only; previewDistributions mutates memory, not ledger

fields.name: accountedBacking
fields.disposition: zero at deployment; actual pull credit/distribution and exact redemption debit

fields.name: allocationDust
fields.disposition: zero; _distribute stores undistributed allocation remainder once

fields.name: stakingDust
fields.disposition: zero; funded _distribute tuple assignment and final fraction/debit rounding

fields.name: feeWeight
fields.disposition: zero; top-up-only nonredeemable fee allocation weight

fields.name: creatorWeight
fields.disposition: zero; top-up-only nonredeemable creator allocation weight

fields.name: gonsOf
fields.disposition: empty mapping; allocated issuance, exact transfer, redemption and owned-fraction retirement

fields.name: rawSY

fields.name: stakingSY
fields.disposition: _initialize once; nonzero distinct registered wrapper

fields.name: rawBacking
